notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese Translation Added!
notes.content:
- Update 1.10

A Brazilian Portuguese translation has been added to the game thanks to Filipe de Lima. Enjoy!

tags.feature: - A Brazilian Portuguese translation has been added to the game thanks to Filipe de Lima.

notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content:
Fixed a few grammar and punctuation errors.

I also want to inform you that several new languages are coming soon. These are:

- French
- German
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Polish
- Italian
- Turkish

These languages are also likely to be added but are not yet a sure thing:

- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Czech
- Hungarian
- Romanian

tags.bug: Fixed a few grammar and punctuation errors.

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
Text fixes yet again. Corrected grammar, typos, and punctuation for the whole game. 

Also, added MP to some enemies as they ran out too quickly.

Lastly, I want to mention that a Spanish translation is being worked on at the moment, so you can look forward to that eventually.
